definitions.explanation: The technique of briefly searing the surface of food (especially sushi and sashimi) with an open flame, or food prepared this way. The searing adds a smoky flavor while keeping the inside raw.

examples.japanese: {炙|あぶ}り⟦サーモン→サーモン：08836_saamon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧だ。
バーナー⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{炙|あぶ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{立|た}てる→引き立てる：12585_hikitateru⟧。
examples.english: Torching enhances the flavor of the dish.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{炙|あぶ}り{寿司|ずし}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{目|め}の{前|まえ}→目の前：22588_menomae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{炙|あぶ}って→炙る：09006_aburu⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: At this restaurant, the seared sushi is torched right in front of you after you order.

notes:
USAGE:
{炙|あぶ}り is used both as a noun (the technique or the dish) and as a prefix before the ingredient name. It has become popular at conveyor-belt sushi restaurants and modern sushi bars.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {炙|あぶ}り⟦サーモン→サーモン：08836_saamon⟧ (seared salmon)
- {炙|あぶ}り{寿司|ずし} (seared sushi)
- {炙|あぶ}り⟦{鯖|さば}→鯖：08655_saba⟧ (seared mackerel)
- {炙|あぶ}りトロ (seared fatty tuna)

From the verb ⟦{炙|あぶ}る→炙る：09006_aburu⟧ (to broil, to sear over an open flame).
